LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, ar161500

Manuscript, pen-and-ink and watercolors. Mounted on cloth backing. Printed label describing the map mounted on verso. Watermarks: IV, fleur-de-lis, and other unidentifiable watermark. Depths shown by soundings. Annotated in black (?) ink on verso prior to mounting on cloth backing: 69 and 378. Shows Gulf Coast from Mississippi River Delta to Apalachee Bay, Florida.
